topic: The Physics of Refraction: Why Light Bends

sections.title: Hook & The Prerequisite: Light's Speed in Vacuum
lecture_lines: Why does a straw look broken in water?
Light travels at constant speed in a vacuum.

sections.title: Defining Refractive Index (n)
lecture_lines: Think of light running through deep sand.
Formula n equals c over v.

sections.title: Snell’s Law: The Geometric Rule
lecture_lines: Snell's Law predicts how light bends.
Wavefronts hit the medium at an angle.
Slowing down causes the wavefront to pivot.

sections.title: Mathematical Visualization
lecture_lines: Snell's Law is n1 sin theta1 equals n2 sin theta2.
The beam bends toward or away from normal.
Angles change in real-time as beam rotates.

sections.title: Real-World Application & Summary
lecture_lines: Refraction allows us to see clearly.
Eyes focus light onto the retina.
Refraction is fundamental to all lenses.
